item.title: Millions at risk of displacement as Israel bombards Lebanon
item.description: After 15 months of a fragile ceasefire, Lebanon woke up on March 2 to the familiar sounds of Israeli bombs. As the violence escalates and tens of thousands are displaced, Lebanon’s social divisions threaten to worsen an already dire situation.

item.title: Israel ‘strangles’ West Bank amid war on Iran
item.description: With the world's attention focused on the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran, Israel is making conditions unlivable for Palestinians in the West Bank. Residents say that every Israeli measure to "strangle" Palestinians feels like it's "irreversible."

item.title: A David Frum response to Ro Khanna shows how hasbara culture has warped the Jewish community’s response to antisemitism
item.description: When Ro Khanna made a sharp joke in response to an AIPAC smear, David Frum didn't see politics but 3,000 years of Jew-hatred. That is hasbara culture in action.

item.title: Israel’s goal in Iran is not just regime change, but complete collapse
item.description: For Israel, a failed Iranian state fractured by civil war is preferable to any other outcome. They don’t want to just change the regime in Iran, they want to collapse the state itself.

item.title: In Photos: A love letter to Gaza
item.description: Before the genocide, life in Gaza was both unbearably hard and unbearably beautiful.

item.title: U.S. support for Israel continues to plummet, despite media’s best efforts
item.description: A fake scandal involving Rama Duwaji’s Instagram likes reveals how desperate pro-Israel pundits are grasping at straws as support for the country plummets in the U.S.

item.title: Why is Israel trying to cause an ‘explosion’ in the West Bank?
item.description: Israel is cracking down on Palestinians in the West Bank and pushing the territory to the brink of a major conflagration. Here's why.

item.title: World Council of Churches calls on governments to hold Israel accountable for violations of international law
item.description: The World Council of Churches' new campaign called “From Condemnation to Consequences” aims to pressure governments to hold Israel accountable for its deepening occupation of the West Bank and its accelerated program of genocide and ethnic cleansing.

item.title: In fond memory of Walid Khalidi, the historian of Palestine
item.description: Walid Khalidi may be remembered as the diplomatic gentleman-scholar who became one of Palestine’s greatest historians. But he was also a teacher, a leader, and a pioneer whose life was entirely devoted to and consumed by the question of Palestine.

item.title: Exclusive: Congresswoman Rashida Tlaib demands Leqaa Kordia’s release, says ‘I’m afraid she’s going to die in there’
item.description: In an exclusive interview with Mondoweiss, U.S. Rep. Rashida Tlaib speaks about her visit with ICE detainee Leqaa Kordia in Texas, the detention industrial complex, and attacks on free speech in America.
